content.short: ElkFinance is a peer-to-peer network enabling cross-chain value transfers with the ElkNet engine.
content.description: ElkFinance is a cross-chain network for value transfers and blockchain interoperability. The ElkNet cross-chain engine enables secure and efficient transfers of value and information across blockchains. ElkFinance includes a cross-chain utility token, $ELK, which doubles as the governance token, supports cross-chain swaps among all connected blockchains, and provides Impermanent Loss Protection (ILP) for liquidity providers. A stablecoin named CHFT is planned to facilitate cross-chain value transfers and payments.
